request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD

layers.text: Change only one thing: remove the brown beard and the brown hair completely, so his big chin, heavy jaw and cheeks are bare green skin, colour #4a8a3a, with a lighter green #6faa55 chin and jaw; keep the two cream tusks and the grumpy mouth. Do not redraw anything else: keep the eyes, nose, ears, tin cap, round shield with its yellow rim, cleaver, straps, kilt, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
